violations.text: Menu lacked an allergen statement. PIC added statement to menu during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by equipment/utensils. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC relocated items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The hand-washing sinks in the upstairs restrooms were lacking proper hand washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The downstairs and upstairs bars are lacking a hand-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (air fryer basket) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the rear, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
Cutting board located in the bar area was not in good repair (cracks). New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

Wood is used in the construction of a counter in the kitchen area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the bar 3 bay sinks. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the bar chest cooler has an accumulation of wet cardboard. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
The receptacles in the women's toilet rooms is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026
The wall in the downstairs bar area is in poor repair (hole in wall near ice machine). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
The floor and wall junctures in the in the kitchen do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. New Violation. Correct By: 01/23/2024

Per interview of staff, slicers are only washed and rinsed. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 01/23/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/23/2024
The door to the women's toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 01/23/2024
